decisions.reason: Exact paste_image/paste_file scheme with (2),(3) suffix before extension, per-base probing of the taken set, in-batch reservation (taken.add per item), rename applied only at the paste acquisition boundary before add/validateItems; drop and picker paths stay verbatim.

Names composer snapshot occurrences as the authoritative taken-set, cites the line-36 subscription retiring records on a momentary empty snapshot while the attachment is live, and unions in-batch reservations; records explicitly demoted to supplement.

Root-causes via the cached HIT page (x-cache, age, v0.2.9 max) rendered through renderCurrentChip(tag); gives a T vs PLUGIN_VERSION table: show update only when T > R, green chip shows R, T < R treated as stale and never displayed as latest.

A2/A3 cover repeated and same-batch pastes with concrete names, A8 forces records eviction while the occurrence stays live, A6 pins drop/picker names; B1/B2/B3 test stale/older, equal, and genuinely newer remote tags against the running build.

Syncs package.json with the hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION plus a CI guard, requires node --check on shipped bytes and behavioral suites, and explains the real update path (package-manager install in the profile, host restart, hard refresh) noting no host-side update endpoint exists.
